targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-970 (H1, content-referencing objective) did NOT adjudicate its leg, and -- contrary to a reading its headline numbers invite -- it produced NO evidence that the objective family is capable. Regime A (real agent latents) never produced its load-bearing DV: probe_heldout_real_latent_jaccard was null in 12/12 cells because the held-out gate requires >208 dangerous states and every cell yielded 171-195, so Regime A scored out in every possible world at this schedule, collapsing the OR-across-regimes criterion to a single regime. Regime B (a synthetic 2-cluster stream) is where the eye-catching number lives: the trained arm reached Jaccard 0.0 on 6/6 seeds on probe_2cluster_jaccard_TRAINED_clusters. That readout evaluates on the exact bases the arm trained on. The portfolio's own GENERALIZATION readout, on a fresh cluster pair from the same generative family, is FLAT: mean_probe_2cluster_jaccard_fresh_clusters_regime_b is 0.4166666666666667 for the trained arm and 0.4166666666666667 for the untrained arm -- identical to full float precision. Regime B is a bare write_addr_tagger MLP (no env, no agent, no write() during training) run for 15,000 Adam steps on two fixed centroids, with final_h1_loss = -2.0 on 6/6, i.e. saturated at the L1 maximum. That is memorisation of two points with zero transfer, not a demonstration of content-conditioning capability. The gate defect is nonetheless real and independent: with 2 of 6 paired diffs exactly zero the exact sign-flip p-grid floors at 1/2^4 = 0.0625 against alpha_corrected 0.025, so no outcome could have cleared the significance bar (the driver's own n=5->6 fix assumed zero ties and does not close it). H1 therefore remains formally ALIVE only because Regime A -- the real-latent regime that would have tested it -- never ran; the synthetic regime's result does not support the leg.
learning_extracted: A significance gate whose attainable p-grid floor exceeds its own alpha is unfalsifiable; the floor is set by the TIE COUNT in the untrained baseline, which is not under the experimenter's control. The driver's own n=5->6 fix assumed zero ties and did not close it.

A held-out split sized by an absolute constant (N_HELDOUT=200) against a class count the environment's early-termination schedule determines (~180) is unreachable by construction; size held-out splits as a FRACTION of realised class count, or assert reachability at design time.

When a driver computes both a trained-set and a fresh-set readout, the SCIENTIFIC claim belongs to the fresh-set one. Here they diverge maximally -- 0.0 on the trained clusters, 0.4167 (== untrained) on fresh -- and reading only the first would have credited a capability the run does not show.

targets.recommended_epistemic_category_note: Failure mode is measurement_test_design_defect (baseline mismatch + DV saturation).
targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-969 (H2, operating point) reports its null as holding, and on DIRECTION the seed-matched data support that null MORE strongly than the run itself showed -- the reverse of what the manifest's reported deltas suggest. Phase B carries no untrained arm at its own seeds and is graded against Phase A's disjoint 10-seed pool (mean 0.85). Because the untrained tagger never receives gradient, its probe value is a deterministic function of seed, and the seed-matched untrained baseline for Phase B's seeds [42,7,13,100,200,300] is [0.0,1.0,1.0,0.0,0.0,0.5] (mean 0.4167). Recomputed seed-matched, every operating point's MEAN moved Jaccard the WRONG way by about 0.5 (W0P1 -0.500, W2P0 -0.500, W8P0 -0.472; one-sided sign-flip p(drop) 0.969/0.969/0.938), against the -0.067/-0.067/-0.039 the cross-seed-set comparison reported -- 7-12x larger and in the same direction. Per seed the split is identical across all three configs: 4 of 6 seeds worse (42, 100, 200 by 1.0; 300 by 0.5), 1 tied (13), and 1 -- seed 7 -- BETTER by 0.5 (0.667 under w=8.0). So the claim is about means and the majority of seeds, NOT about every seed: seed 7 improved under all three weights, and it is the only cell in the leg that did. Phase A agrees: the paired sign test returned p=1.0 with 8 of 10 seeds tied at delta 0 (both arms pinned at Jaccard 1.0) and, of the two seeds that moved, BOTH moved the wrong way (n_seeds_correct_direction = 0, n_seeds_wrong_direction = 2). So the baseline mismatch was CONSERVATIVE for the null, and no tested operating point improved content discrimination. The surviving objection is resolution, not direction: two settings 20x apart (w=0.1, w=2.0) produced bit-identical per-seed DV vectors and identical occupied sets, and 8/10 Phase A seeds sat pinned at the DV's worst value, so the instrument cannot certify that NO operating point anywhere would work -- only that none of these four did, none came close, and all four moved the wrong way on average and on 4 of 6 seeds. H2 stays alive on that residual, not on any positive signal.
learning_extracted: An untrained baseline is a deterministic function of seed (random init), so a baseline pool must be seed-matched to the arms it grades. Here the mismatch happened to be conservative for the null, but that was luck: the same defect with the signs reversed would have manufactured a positive.
Two weight settings 20x apart returning a bit-identical per-seed DV vector is a statement about the instrument's resolution, not about the mechanism's insensitivity to gain.

A directional null can be well-supported by an instrument too coarse to license the corresponding universal claim: 'none of these four operating points helped, all four hurt' is earned here; 'no operating point could help' is not.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-971 (H3, task-coupled objective) did NOT adjudicate its leg, and its 'null confirmed' label is not supportable. Its load-bearing criterion is a bare mean-margin comparison at n=5 with no permutation test and no multiplicity correction -- the precise reading both sibling drivers demote to non-gating on this same DV, citing measured false-positive rates of 25-68% (V3-EXQ-969) and ~15% (V3-EXQ-970). The trained arm's write behaviour collapsed toward the single-slot regime the substrate entry contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy exists to prevent (entropy 3.96-3.98 -> 0.785-1.484 bits; self_repeat_rate 0.059-0.064 -> 0.714-0.882) with Jaccard pinned at 1.0 on 5/5 seeds. learning_extracted: A rising training loss on the objective under test voids a null: the mechanism was not instantiated, so its absence of effect is uninformative. Assert objective convergence as a precondition, not a descriptive footnote.

When two sibling drivers in the same portfolio demote a criterion as unusable on a shared DV, a third leg using it as its GATE is a portfolio-level inconsistency that a design audit should catch before queueing.

targets.recommended_epistemic_category_note: This target is a genuine measurement; the label's 'h4_supported' half derives from an explicitly non-gating reading and should not be read as the leg being adjudicated.
targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-972 (H4, input distribution) is the one leg of the portfolio that produced a load-bearing measurement, and its PASS is NOT a scientific verdict: the gating criterion is declared in the manifest as 'a MEASUREMENT criterion, not a pass/fail on a scientific direction', and the driver states 'do not read passed: true here as H4 refuted or passed: false as H4 supported'. The measurement itself is substantive and first-of-kind: train-time write-stream latents sit in a narrow cone with intra-class cosine 0.980 (safe) / 0.971 (dangerous) against inter-class cosine 0.948, giving a mean separability score of 0.0281 across 5 seeds. Safe and dangerous states are very nearly collinear in the write stream under this statistic -- the SD-008 under-differentiation cone, measured at training time for the first time in this lineage. HEDGE: separability_score is an UNCENTRED cosine contrast, which is insensitive to structure that a learned projection could still exploit (a common mean dominates all three cosines). It therefore supports 'the classes are not linearly separated in the raw write stream', NOT the stronger 'there is no structure for any objective to condition on'. The cheap confirmer for the stronger claim is a linear probe (logistic regression, safe-vs-dangerous, held-out) on the same recorded latents. The 'h4_supported' half of the label comes from comparing 0.0281 against a floor the manifest itself calls 'a conservative noise floor ... not a rigorously derived value', so the DIRECTION is well-evidenced while the threshold crossing is not. The non-gating cross-reference probe reproduces V3-EXQ-956 cell-for-cell and set-for-set (J = [1.0, 0.5, 0.333, 0.5, 1.0], mean 0.667), confirming instrument stability across drivers. H4 remains alive pending a comparator, but is now the best-supported leg.
learning_extracted: Train-time write-stream latents are near-collinear across the safe/dangerous distinction under an uncentred cosine contrast (separability 0.0281; inter-class cosine 0.948). First train-time measurement of the SD-008 cone in this lineage, and it reframes the portfolio toward the input distribution.

An uncentred cosine contrast cannot distinguish 'no structure' from 'structure not aligned with the raw axis'; a held-out linear probe is the cheap upgrade and should be added to the recording standard for this family.
A single-arm descriptive measurement can be the most informative leg of a portfolio whose comparative legs are instrument-limited.

cluster_pattern.shape: One mis-posed instrument, used unchanged by all four legs against an on-the-record directive not to build against it. Three legs returned readings the instrument cannot license at the strength claimed; the fourth returned the portfolio's only load-bearing measurement, and it points upstream of everything the other three tested.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: The 2-cluster occupied-set Jaccard DV (PROBE_CLUSTERS=2, PROBE_JITTER=0.0078, n=5-10) is near-binary: portfolio-wide, 72 of 89 cells carrying probe_2cluster_occupied have BOTH clusters' occupied set at cardinality 1, so Jaccard can only be 0.0 or 1.0. (Restricted to the 53 cells in 969/971/972 the figure is 45/53; the fuller denominator is the honest one.) A near-binary DV at n=5-10 cannot resolve graded change, saturates paired tests with ties (969 Phase A: 8/10 tied, p=1.0 -- the test's maximum), and forces exact permutation p-grids whose floor can exceed the corrected alpha (970 Regime B: 0.0625 vs 0.025). Every comparative conclusion in the portfolio inherits this. The substrate entry contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy recorded the property on 2026-08-29 and directed, verbatim, 'DO NOT build a third loss design against C2 as currently written ... redesign the instrument -- e.g. mutual information over the contingency table, not set-Jaccard'. Two of the four legs (H1/970, H3/971) are new loss designs graded against the unchanged instrument.
cluster_pattern.not_a_common_factor: An earlier draft of this autopsy also named a '~10x under-run training budget' as a shared cause. That is WITHDRAWN on measurement: the realised step counts equal V3-EXQ-956's seed-for-seed (956 GUMBEL_UNTRAINED [1546,1460,1478,1576,1446] == 970 REGIME_A_UNTRAINED on the five shared seeds), so the gap to the nominal 15,000 is the harness's ordinary early-termination schedule -- episodes break on `done`, dangerous episodes ending at ~3.8 steps -- and is exactly the schedule the substrate entry registered as 'a real training schedule'. Under-training therefore cannot explain any difference from 956. Recorded rather than deleted: the argument was tested and did not hold. It does remain the mechanism behind 970's unreachable N_HELDOUT=200 gate.
cluster_pattern.convergent_read: Three of the four legs point AWAY from 'a better write-side objective fixes this', and the fourth measures an input stream with little exploitable structure. Specifically: H2's seed-matched contrast shows every tested operating point moving Jaccard the WRONG way by ~0.5 (0/10 seeds improving in Phase A); H3's coupled objective did not train (loss rose 0.6273 -> 0.6514) and its arm collapsed toward the single-slot regime; H1 showed no transferable capability even on a synthetic stream engineered to have content structure (trained-cluster Jaccard 0.0 but fresh-cluster Jaccard 0.4167, identical to untrained); and H4 measured real train-time latents at separability 0.0281. The leading hypothesis is that the binding constraint sits UPSTREAM of the addressing policy, in the write stream's representation. IMPORTANT LIMITS, stated because an earlier draft of this autopsy overstated exactly here: (1) H1's synthetic result is memorisation of two centroids with zero generalization, NOT a demonstration that the objective family is capable -- that claim is withdrawn; (2) H4's statistic is an uncentred cosine contrast and cannot distinguish 'no structure' from 'structure off the raw axis'; (3) the near-binary DV limits all three comparative legs. This is the hypothesis the redesigned instrument should be built to test, not a finding to apply.
